== Pre-reorg set index (VS1-18 + Premium) ==

'''Do not confuse''' these numbered sets with [[:Category:Current Virtual sets|post-2014 Virtual Sets]] (e.g. current [[Virtual Set 1]]) or with [[Virtual Block 1|VB1]]-[[Virtual Block 9|VB9]] hubs.

'''Primary slip PDFs''' on [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/ res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/]: '''VirtualCards1a.pdf''' (Set 1 -- use this; <code>VirtualCards1.pdf</code> returns '''403''' on the current CDN) and <code>VirtualCards2.pdf</code> ... <code>VirtualCards17.pdf</code>. For '''early modifier framing''', Bill's Wayback copy remains useful: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf IA VirtualCards1.pdf].<ref name="vc1pdf" /><ref name="vc1a_res">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks</ref>

'''Theme names''' also appear on the 2008 Icon Guide ([http://karcianki.pl/files/sw/Icon%20Guide.pdf Icon Guide.pdf]) and in PC Block intros (including "Virtual Set: Defensive Shields").<ref name="iconguide">[http://karcianki.pl/files/sw/Icon%20Guide.pdf SWCCG Icon Guide] (karcianki.pl host; PC 2008 imprint)</ref>

=== Errata / official-text layers (pre-Block) ===

These are '''version stamps''' on surviving PDFs -- not a claim that each date is the only reprint, and '''not''' a drop-list.

{| class="wikitable"
! Layer stamp !! What it marks !! Conf. !! Notes
|-
| '''4 December 2006''' "Official text as of..." || V7-V11 slip PDFs on res || '''high''' as stamp; '''low''' as first-ship || Redux-era packaging caveat -- do not treat as proven original ship dates
|-
| '''Jun-Sep 2007''' file CreationDates / builds || e.g. V8/V9 Sep 2007 metadata; V13 Aug 2007 || '''med''' || File dates are not always printed legal days
|-
| '''Per-set V12-V17''' official-text / metadata lines || V12 9 Jan 2007; V15 21 Mar 2008; V16 15 Aug 2008; V17 6 Feb 2009; etc. || '''high''' where "Official text as of" prints || See table rows
|-
| '''7 December 2009''' Block "Official text as of..." || VirtualBlock1-5.pdf (and peers) || '''high''' || Reorg of previous 18 sets into six thematic blocks<ref name="blockreorg" />
|}

'''Drops:''' Virtual cards '''can be dropped''' from the legal pool (and errata'd) across eras. A sourced '''drop-list''' is '''not''' published here yet -- later wiki slice.

=== Spot-check: early modifier != Block packaging ===

Example (illustrative, '''not''' a full diff): early Virtual '''Luke (V)''' modifier framing on the 2002-era slips is '''not''' the same presentation as Luke-line cards in [[Virtual Block 1]] packaging. A later wiki page will compare old Virtual modifiers vs Block-era / current Virtual '''card-by-card'''; this page only flags that the layers diverge.

'''Still open:''' first-ship dates for V5-V6 and V7-V11; Premium Shields legal day; V18 legal day / whether a public slip PDF shipped.
